page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review guidance. Each = a directive description, a type, and a markdown body you can attach to any agent.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

injectionBanner.title: INJECTION DETECTED — DO NOT ENABLE
injectionBanner.body: This skill contains prompt injection patterns. It has been automatically blocked.

newSkill.title: Create skill
newSkill.subtitle: A skill is a name, a directive description, a type, and a markdown body.
newSkill.slugError: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, at least two characters, starting with a letter or digit.

config.title: Configuration
config.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive, saying when the skill applies.
config.versionMessageHint: A short note on what changed — shown on this version's row in Versions.
config.willSnapshotAs: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}
config.dangerZoneBody: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.

empty.title: No eval cases yet
empty.body: No eval cases yet — create one from a diff, or turn a finding into a skill eval case on a PR

evals.lift: Lift vs. without skill — recall {recall} · precision {precision} · citation {citation}

runHint.noAgent: Link this skill to an agent first
runHint.running: A run is already in progress for this skill

runDialog.title: Run skill evals
runDialog.carrierHelp: Every case is reviewed twice by this agent: once with the skill and once without it.
runDialog.counts: {cases, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}} · {reviews, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}
runDialog.injectionWarning: This skill was flagged for prompt injection — its text is sent to the model in every with-skill review
runDialog.disabledWarning: This skill or its link to {carrier} is disabled — the with-skill arm includes it anyway

stats.pullFrequencyHint: Runs that included this skill ÷ runs by agents linked to it.
stats.findingsHint: From runs that included this skill — run-level, not per-finding attribution.
stats.acceptRateHint: Accepted ÷ settled findings from those same runs.
stats.noAgents: Not linked to any agent yet.
stats.noCategories: No findings in this window yet.

versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.usedByWarning: Linked to: {agents}. Deleting this skill removes those links too. This cannot be undone.
delete.noAgents: Not linked to any agent. This cannot be undone.

import.tooLarge: That file is larger than 512 KB — split it or trim it before importing.
import.executableWarning: Executable members — not imported, never run.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Read it before you enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side. An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt — read it before you enable it.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: The exact text sent to the model when this skill is enabled.
preview.untrustedNotice: An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

context.title: Context
context.hint: Attach repository documents this skill needs. Every agent that has this skill enabled receives them too. Order matters — earlier documents are added to the prompt first.
